# Hardware fixtures

Representative sanitized command-output fixtures, authored for parser tests. They are not measurements of the owner's machine and establish no physical acceptance. NVIDIA CSV fields/units follow the [official NVIDIA query documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/deploy/nvidia-smi/index.html); memory values are MiB under `nounits`. Other files model Linux `/proc`, `lspci -D`, `lsblk --json --bytes` and efivarfs outputs. No test invokes a GPU or network service.
